reasons_for_falsification: Universal B1 requires int(V_log - G) dt <= 0. On short subintervals (Delta t in [0.02, 0.15]), local viscous Laplacian diffusion nu * (omega_hat . Delta omega)/|omega| can be strictly positive and exceed G = lambda_3 - lambda_omega in steep gradient regions.

surviving_conditional_theorems.name: Conditional Bound B1-C1 (Viscous Dissipation Sector)
surviving_conditional_theorems.statement: If V_log(t) <= 0 pointwise along the trajectory (i.e. viscous diffusion is non-amplifying), then ln(|w2|/|w1|) <= int_{t1}^{t2} lambda_3 dt holds identically (zero violations).

surviving_conditional_theorems.name: Conditional Bound B1-C2 (Inviscid Euler)
surviving_conditional_theorems.statement: In inviscid Euler (nu = 0), V_log = 0 identically, so ln(|w2|/|w1|) = int lambda_omega dt <= int lambda_3 dt holds universally.

surviving_conditional_theorems.name: Safe Viscous Upper Envelope B1-SAFE
surviving_conditional_theorems.statement: ln(|w2|/|w1|) <= int_{t1}^{t2} [lambda_3(s) + max(0, V_log(s))] ds holds universally across all 124,800 tested intervals (0 violations).
